name: Quartier Bonanjo
description: Bonanjo is a central district of Douala, Cameroon's largest city and main port. It is known as an administrative and historic urban area. Individual building names, private museum hours and entry prices are not listed here.
culture: Douala is the economic capital of Cameroon. Walking through Bonanjo is a common way to see the city's public architecture. Unverified colonial-era anecdotes are omitted.
